title: Waste Water Treatment
description: Team Project - 3D Visualization for an Electro-Reactive Waste Water Treatment system.
process: The Waste Water Treatment Visualization had a relatively quick turnaround, so it was rendered entirely in Blender Cycles. I specifically worked on the Preivs/Animatic, and created the Microscopic Molecule Visualization, making a Geo-Node setup to scatter particles and simulate the heavy metals' attraction to the Carbon Atoms. To do this, I offset the heavy metals using a vector volume representing velocity/attraction to the Carbon Molecules. I generated this volume with the Gradient Vector on the signed distance to each Carbon Atom. The molecule shader itself was a simple Fresnel and Transluscent Refraction, colored and animated to represent polarity.
